Stand Alone Surface Mount Door Alarms

text.description_html:
DETEX EAX-500, Battery Powered Door Alarm

DETEX EAX-500 door alarm uses 9 volt battery - Easy to install with no wiring to run. Some applications include: restricted doors, emergency fire escape doors, nursing home stairwell doors, rear restaurant and theater doors.

The Stand Alone Surface Mount Door Alarm is a magnetic contact controlled door alarm. This means it is surface mounted to the door and a magnet is mounted on the door frame. When the door opens, the alarm sounds; and this is one loud alarm--sounding at over 100 decibels.

It can be put in one of two operating modes. The first is Always Armed, where the alarm will sound every time the door is opened. The second mode is ON/OFF; in this mode, the operator can manually arm or disarm the device with a key (Note: Mortise lock cylinder sold separate. Uses 1-1/4" mortise cylinder with Standard Yale style cam).

Features of the DETEX EAX-500 Door Alarm:

  • Annunciator Feature (beeps when door opens).
  • Arming Delay Time: 15 seconds.
  • Self-contained and dual-tamper supervised.
  • Piezo siren that sounds at over 95db.
  • Easy to install: Self contained.
  • Low battery alert.
  • LED Status indicator on the front of the housing..

Specifications of the DETEX EAX-500 Door Alarm:

  • Height:7.70" (19.56 cm)
  • Width: 2.10" (5.33 cm)
  • Projection: 2-3/8" (6.03 cm)
  • Color: Gray Finish
  • Lock Cylinder: Requires 1-1/4" Mortise lock cylinder (Not Included).
  • Requires a 9V battery (Included).
  • DETEX EAX-500 Installation Instructions (PDF)

*Note: Mortise lock cylinder sold separate. Uses 1-1/4" mortise cylinder with Standard Yale style cam.

**Set includes 9 volt battery, Sensor kit, Red Warning Sign and installation hardware.

Sold Individually
